rpts.counterparty: Gulf International Bank Saudi Arabia (GIB) — ~98% owned by PIF
rpts.description: Revolving credit facility to Lucid LLC, renewed Feb 2025 and increased to SAR 1.9bn (~$506.6M), maturing Feb 24, 2028; peak 2025 principal outstanding SAR 1,785.0M (~$476.0M); SAR 1,755.0M (~$468.0M) outstanding at 12/31/2025.
rpts.quote: On February 24, 2025, Lucid LLC entered into an agreement with GIB to renew the 2023 GIB Credit Facility (the “2025 GIB Credit Facility Agreement,” and together with the 2023 GIB Facility Agreement, the “Amended GIB Facility Agreement”), maturing on February 24, 2028, to increase the credit facility committed amount from SAR 1.0 billion (approximately $266.1 million) to SAR 1.9 billion (approximately $506.6 million) (the “2025 GIB Credit Facility”).

rpts.description: Unsecured delayed draw term loan credit facility, increased to $1.98bn in Nov 2025 and to ~$2.5bn (drawn + undrawn) via April 14, 2026 amendment; $500.0M drawn April 1, 2026; maturity Aug 4, 2029; minimum liquidity covenant eliminated.
rpts.quote: In November 2025, the Company increased the aggregate principal amount of the DDTL Credit Facility from $750.0 million to $1.98 billion.

rpts.description: Prepaid forward transaction tied to 2030 Notes; Ayar to purchase ~$430.0M of common stock; Company pays Ayar periodic fee of 0.5% per annum.
rpts.quote: In connection with the pricing of the 5.00% Convertible Senior Notes due in April 2030 (the "2030 Notes"), Ayar entered into a privately negotiated prepaid forward transaction on April 2, 2025 with a forward counterparty that is an affiliate of one of the initial purchasers of the 2030 Notes, pursuant to which Ayar will purchase approximately $430.0 million of the Company’s common stock with delivery expected to occur on or about the maturity date for the 2030 Notes, subject to the ability of the forward counterparty to elect to settle all or a portion of the prepaid forward transaction early.

rpts.description: Prepaid forward transaction tied to 2031 Notes; Ayar to purchase ~$636.7M of common stock; Company pays Ayar periodic fee (2025 fee incurred $2.0M, $1.1M paid).
rpts.quote: In connection with the pricing of the 7.00% Convertible Senior Notes due in November 2031 (the "2031 Notes"), Ayar entered into a privately negotiated prepaid forward transaction on November 11, 2025 with a forward counterparty that is an affiliate of one of the initial purchasers of the 2031 Notes, pursuant to which Ayar will purchase approximately $636.7 million of the Company’s common stock with delivery expected to occur on or about the maturity date for the 2031 Notes, subject to the ability of the forward counterparty to elect to settle all or a portion of the prepaid forward transaction early.

rpts.description: April 2026 Subscription Agreement: Ayar purchases 55,000 shares of Series C Convertible Preferred Stock for $550.0M.
rpts.quote: On April 14, 2026, we entered into a subscription agreement (the “April 2026 Subscription Agreement”) with Ayar, pursuant to which Ayar agreed to purchase 55,000 shares of our Series C Convertible Preferred Stock, par value $0.0001 per share (“Series C Convertible Preferred Stock”), for an aggregate purchase price of  $550.0 million in a private placement.

rpts.description: Sixth IRA Amendment granting registration rights for shares purchased under prepaid forwards.
rpts.quote: Pursuant to the Sixth IRA Amendment, Ayar is entitled to certain registration rights, including demand, piggy-back and shelf registration rights, with respect to the shares of Common Stock to be purchased in connection with the Ayar prepaid forward transactions.

rpts.description: Seventh IRA Amendment granting registration rights for Series C preferred and underlying common.
rpts.quote: Pursuant to the Seventh IRA Amendment, Ayar will be entitled to certain registration rights, including demand, piggyback and shelf registration rights, with respect to the shares of Series C Convertible Preferred Stock purchased pursuant to the April 2026 Subscription Agreement and any shares of Common Stock issuable upon conversion thereof.

rpts.description: EV Purchase Agreement for up to 100,000 vehicles; 2025 net vehicle sales SAR 540.2M (~$144.0M).
rpts.quote: The Company recognized net vehicle sales amount of SAR 540.2 million (approximately $144.0 million) during the year ended December 31, 2025.

rpts.description: First Vehicle Production Agreement: minimum commitment of 20,000 Lucid Gravity Plus vehicles.
rpts.quote: On July 16, 2025, we entered into a Vehicle Production Agreement (“First VPA”) with Uber Technologies, Inc. (“Uber”), under which Uber and its designated fleet operators have agreed to purchase a minimum commitment of 20,000 Lucid Gravity vehicles that have been modified to include certain autonomous driving hardware and other features (the “Lucid Gravity Plus vehicles”) over a six-year period following the start of production.

rpts.description: Second Vehicle Production Agreement: minimum commitment of 25,000 Lucid Midsize Plus vehicles.
rpts.quote: On April 14, 2026, we entered into a Second Vehicle Production Agreement (the “Second VPA”) with Uber, under which Uber and its designated fleet operators have agreed to purchase a minimum commitment of 25,000 Lucid Midsize vehicles (the “Second VPA Minimum Quantity Guarantee”) for use as robotaxis that have been modified to include certain autonomous driving hardware and other features (the “Lucid Midsize Plus vehicles”) over a six-year period following the start of production.

rpts.description: 2026 Uber Private Placement: $200.0M purchase of Common Stock (common equity, not credit) with 18-month lockup.
rpts.quote: On April 14, 2026, we entered into a subscription agreement with a subsidiary of Uber, SMB Holding Corporation (“SMB”), under which we agreed to issue and SMB agreed to purchase $200.0 million of our Common Stock in a private placement (the “2026 Uber Private Placement”).
